verdict.rationale: Belvo documents registrable outbound webhooks. You configure a URL to receive notifications plus an optional authorization token, and recurrent links refresh data and notify you via webhook. Its docs also provide forkable webhook projects for testing. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of event types, delivery details such as retries and signature verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: URL: the URL to receive the webhook notifications. Authorization: an optional authorization token to use if your URL is protected.
With recurrent links, Belvo automatically refreshes information weekly and notifies you via webhook so you always have up-to-date data.
we have set up the webhooks and the subsequent requests as easy-to-use projects that you can fork
